name: Farrukhsiyar
role: Mughal emperor who formalized Bengal's nawabi phase
contribution: His 1717 settlement formally elevated Murshid Quli Khan, marking a new phase of Bengal's quasi-autonomous nawabi administration.
context: Imperial recognition coexisted with increasing provincial fiscal-political autonomy in Bengal.
impact: The 1717 arrangement helped structure the political order that persisted until the Plassey crisis.
highlight: Farrukhsiyar's 1717 decision helped institutionalize Bengal's nawabi regime.
